title: Visual Engine Contract v1 — shared definitions
description: Shared types for the Visual Engine Contract (VEC). Objects are tolerant readers: unknown properties MUST be ignored by receivers (forward compatibility within a contract MAJOR version). Strict validation applies only to workflow `parameters`, which are validated by each workflow's own input_schema.

ContractVersion.description: MAJOR.MINOR of the Visual Engine Contract.

Semver.description: Workflow version, Semantic Versioning 2.0.0 (no build metadata).

WorkflowKey.description: Stable identifier of a workflow family. Lowercase, digits, underscore and dot. The prefix '__conformance__.' is reserved for contract conformance workflows.

Task.description: What a workflow does, independent of how. Platform business logic only ever reasons about tasks, never about models or node graphs.

PriorityClass.description: Platform scheduling class. P0 (payments) and P1 (fan conversations) never reach the visual engine. time_sensitive=P2, scheduled_image=P3, video=P4, maintenance=P5.

OutputTransfer.description: How outputs are handed to the platform. http_download is mandatory for v1 engines; file_uri is optional and only valid inside a shared content root configured on both sides.

AssetRef.description: A platform-owned asset the engine may read (reference image, previous output to edit). The platform guarantees sha256 integrity; the engine SHOULD verify it after download.

role.description: Semantic role. Known values: face, identity, outfit, pose, environment, style, source (image to edit), mask. Engines ignore roles they do not use.

uri.description: Short-lived signed http(s) URL served by the platform, or file:// URI inside the shared content root.

AdapterRef.description: Optional identity/style adapter (e.g. a character LoRA) produced and registered by the visual track. engine_ref is opaque to the platform.

PersonaIdentity.description: Who the content is of. Persona identity is provided by reference, never embedded model weights.

identity_package_ref.description: Opaque reference to an identity package registered by the visual track (if any).

visual_traits.description: Structured visual identity from the approved persona version (hair, eyes, marks, age presentation, style). Advisory input for prompt construction inside the workflow.

QaResult.description: Engine-side quality measurement. Advisory: the platform applies its own per-persona thresholds and makes the pass/fail decision.

models.description: Opaque model/adapter identifiers and hashes used (for audit and licence tracing). The platform stores but never interprets them.

download_url.description: Absolute URL or path relative to the engine base URL. Required when transfer=http_download.

ErrorClass.description: Failure classification. Determines platform retry behaviour: transient, resource and timeout are retried with backoff; all others are terminal.

code.description: Stable machine code (see README error table). Receivers MUST handle unknown codes using class and retryable.
